title: Travel Product Manager
description:

Hiring: Travel Product Manager

**Company:** Max Holidays India Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** NSP, Pitampura, New Delhi  
**Salary Package:** 50k to 60K  
**Experience:** 4–7 Years  
**Qualification:** Graduate in Travel & Tourism, Hospitality, Business Administration, or a related field.

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced and strategic Travel Product Manager to develop, manage, and enhance our domestic and international travel products. The ideal candidate should have strong destination knowledge, experience in itinerary development, supplier negotiations, costing, and product strategy. The role involves creating competitive travel packages that meet customer expectations while ensuring profitability and business growth.

* Develop, design, and manage domestic and international holiday packages, group tours, and customised travel products.
* Research new destinations, travel trends, customer preferences, and competitor offerings to identify business opportunities.
* Create attractive itineraries, tour programmes, and travel experiences for different customer segments.
* Manage product pricing, costing, profit margins, and package profitability.
* Coordinate with hotels, DMCs, transport providers, airlines, and other travel suppliers to negotiate competitive rates and contracts.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers and destination partners.
* Regularly review and update existing travel products based on market demand, customer feedback, and sales performance.
* Collaborate with the sales, operations, and marketing teams to launch and promote new travel packages.
* Prepare detailed product information, itineraries, inclusions, exclusions, pricing sheets, and sales-support materials.
* Ensure the accuracy of product details, availability, booking conditions, and supplier information.
* Monitor product performance, sales trends, margins, and customer satisfaction.
* Identify opportunities to improve product quality, operational efficiency, and profitability.
* Support the team with destination knowledge, product training, and recommendations for customised client requirements.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 4–7 years of relevant experience in travel product development, tour planning, or product management.
* Strong knowledge of domestic and international destinations.
* Experience in itinerary designing, tour costing, pricing, and supplier negotiations.
* Understanding of travel industry operations, hotel contracting, DMC coordination, and package development.
* Excellent analytical, negotiation, planning, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and presentation tools.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple products and projects while meeting deadlines.

Preferred Candidate

* Experience developing profitable FIT, group, leisure, and customised holiday packages.
* Strong commercial understanding of supplier rates, market pricing, and profit margins.
* Ability to identify emerging destinations and create differentiated travel products.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary based on experience and expertise.
* Opportunity to develop and manage a diverse portfolio of travel products.
* Professional growth within an established travel and tourism company.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**About the company**

Keka is a modern people platform for growing enterprises. HR, payroll and talent live in one core system, so teams spend less time on admin and more time on their people. More than 12,500 companies trust Keka, from fast-growing small businesses to large enterprises and global companies with teams across borders.

We build software the way HR actually works. It feels human, sets up in days instead of months, and has AI built into every part of HR. With customers across India, the US and the Middle East, our Finance and Planning team is growing fast to keep up. That is where this role comes in.

**About the role**

We're hiring an Associate Product Manager to help own **US Payroll**. You'll work on the features that make sure every US employee and contractor is paid accurately and on time, and that taxes, deductions and benefits are handled correctly. It's a role for someone early in their product career who wants to go deep into a hard, high-stakes domain and grow fast.

**What you'll do**

  

* Own features across the US payroll run: pay schedules, regular and off-cycle payrolls, approvals, payroll funding and data checks that keep payroll on time.
* Work on tax setup, employee and contractor tax documents (W-2, 1099), deductions and garnishments.
* Help improve integrations with benefits providers (such as 401(k) and health insurance) and accounting tools (such as QuickBooks).
* Write clear PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, and work closely with Engineering and Design to ship reliable features.
* Talk to US payroll admins and customers. Understand their workflows and pain points and turn them into clear product priorities.
* Work with CX, Implementation and Support to understand escalations, find root causes, and fix recurring themes for good.
* Work with partner teams to understand their APIs and behaviour, and raise and track issues that affect our customers.
* Define success metrics for what you ship, track adoption and correctness, and improve based on data.

**What you'll bring**

  

* 1–2 years of experience in product management, product analysis, business analysis or a similar role in B2B SaaS. Strong freshers with relevant internships are welcome to apply.
* Any exposure to **finance, fintech, payments, accounting, payroll or HR tech** is a strong plus. So is any work with US customers or US-market products.
* A CA, CA-Inter, CPA, CFA or finance degree is a bonus but not required.

*Domain & customer*

* **Curious about money, tax and how payroll works:** you enjoy understanding the rules behind how people get paid, and you want to go deep, not just manage tickets.
* **Learns fast:** you've picked up something complex quickly before, and can explain it simply to others.
* **Customer-led thinking:** you're comfortable talking to users, asking good questions, and finding the real problem behind a request.

*Product craft*

* **Attention to detail:** in payroll, small mistakes matter. You think through edge cases and write clear acceptance criteria.
* **Structured thinking:** you can break a messy problem into clear parts, prioritise, and explain your reasoning.
* **Comfortable with data:** basic SQL, spreadsheets or dashboards. You like checking whether something actually worked after launch.
* **Clear communication:** you write crisply and can keep engineering, design, support and customers on the same page.

*Engineering partnership*

* **Technically curious:** you're comfortable reading API documentation and understanding how data moves between systems, or you're keen to learn quickly.
* **Owns quality:** you test what you ship, and when something breaks, you help find the root cause and push for a lasting fix.
* **A good partner to Engineering:** you work through disagreements with evidence and customer outcomes, and you're open to changing your mind.

*Ways of working*

* **Uses AI tools** to learn faster, research, and work more efficiently.
* **Open to working with US customers and partners,** including some calls in US hours when needed.

**About Solifi**

Solifi deliver a solid financial technology foundation for equipment, working capital, wholesale, and automotive finance firms. At Solifi, we believe that commerce is only as strong as the system it runs on. Our mission is to reshape finance technology by bringing together proven solutions into a singular powerful technology platform designed to help protect and scale financial organizations. We guard our customers by being precise and reliable, we guide their success by combining powerful technology with proven expertise, and we help them grow by unleashing their potential.

  

**About the Team**

We are a small, high ownership AI team operating with the pace and ownership of a startup within a global enterprise. We build production grade AI products that are used by real customers, taking ideas from early experimentation and prototyping through evaluation, production deployment and continuous improvement. The team brings together AI product management, AI engineering and data expertise, with a strong emphasis on shipping, experimentation, quality and measurable customer outcomes. We work closely with product, engineering and domain teams across the business to identify where AI can create meaningful value and then build the systems required to deliver it reliably at scale. This is an opportunity to work on some of the core AI products shaping how modern AI is applied within enterprise software, while having significant influence over what we build, how we evaluate it and how AI products are built and operated in production.

  

**About the Position**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager - AI to lead the development of production grade AI products that solve complex problems for enterprise customers.
  
  
This is a highly hands on product role for someone who understands that building AI products is fundamentally different from building traditional software. You will work at the intersection of product, data, AI, and domain expertise, with significant ownership over both the product outcome and the process used to prove that the AI system can reliably deliver it.
  
  
This is a builder role. You will not simply manage a backlog of AI features or translate requirements between customers and engineering. You will be expected to understand the problem, formulate the hypothesis, work with the data, determine how AI can solve it, establish how success will be measured, validate the solution and drive it all the way into production.
  
  
The goal is not to build AI for the sake of using AI. The goal is to build reliable, production-grade AI products that create measurable value for enterprise customers.

  

**Role and Responsibilities**

Identify high value customer problems, develop hypotheses around where AI can create measurable value and validate those hypotheses using data, experimentation and customer feedback.
  
  
Work hands on with large and complex datasets to understand the problem, identify patterns, test assumptions, and determine what is required to build an effective AI solution.
  
  
Partner with AI engineering and data teams to design AI powered product experiences, including grounding and retrieval systems, prompts, model selection, orchestration and AI workflows.
  
  
Build and own AI evaluation frameworks, including evaluation datasets, golden sets, test cases, metrics, automated evaluations, and human evaluation processes.
  
  
Establish AI monitoring and observability for production systems and use evaluation and production data to identify failures, understand root causes and continuously improve the product.
  
  
Drive AI capabilities from prototype and proof of concept through production deployment, customer adoption and continuous improvement.
  
  
Define and measure the product and AI metrics that demonstrate whether the system is delivering the intended customer outcome.

  

**About You**

What We Are Looking For: • 7+ years of product management experience, with significant experience building and shipping B2B software products. • Strong hands-on experience building AI-powered products, where AI is a core part of the product experience and customer outcome. • Deep practical understanding of AI evaluation and experience building evaluation frameworks for AI products. • Strong experience with AI monitoring and observability, including identifying, diagnosing, and addressing failures in production AI systems. • Strong data skills and experience working with large-scale data. You should be comfortable understanding data structures, exploring datasets, analyzing data, and using data to validate product hypotheses and AI behavior. • Experience designing and building grounding systems and evaluation systems, rather than simply consuming AI APIs. • Experience with modern AI application architectures, including LLMs, RAG, embeddings, prompting, model selection, agents/workflows, and orchestration. • Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous problem, formulate hypotheses, validate them with data and experimentation, and turn the resulting insight into a production product. • Experience building products for B2B customers in heavily regulated industries, such as financial services, fintech, insurance, healthcare, or similar domains. • Strong understanding of enterprise AI considerations including accuracy, reliability, explainability, security, governance, data quality, and auditability. • Ability to work deeply with technical teams and engage in detailed discussions about AI system behavior without needing to be the engineer implementing the system. • Familiarity with the AWS ecosystem is preferred. • Strong product judgment and the ability to distinguish between an impressive AI demo and an AI system that is genuinely reliable enough for production use. What Will Set You Apart: • You have taken an AI product from hypothesis prototype evaluation production continuous monitoring and improvement. • You have personally designed or owned an AI evaluation framework and understand why evaluation is central to building reliable AI products. • You have worked through difficult AI failure modes and know how to investigate whether a problem originates in the model, data, retrieval, grounding, prompting, orchestration, or product workflow. • You have experience building AI products where incorrect outputs have meaningful business or customer consequences. • You are comfortable challenging an initial hypothesis when the data or evaluations do not support it. • You naturally think in terms of measurable customer outcomes rather than AI features. • You enjoy getting into the details and are equally comfortable discussing a customer workflow, analyzing an evaluation dataset, investigating AI output failures, and working with engineers on the product architecture.

  

**Preferred Experience Level**

7 years

  

**Preferred Education Level**

Master's Degree

  

**Employment Basis**

Group Medical Insurance, Group Personal Accident, Employee Anniversary gift, Loyalty Bonus, Employee Referral Bonus, Rewards and Recognition program, Wellness Allowance, Privilege Leave (PL): 15 days per year, Casual Leave (CL) 12 days per year, Maternity/paternity/Bereavement leave

**About Us**  
Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology.

**About the Role**  
We are looking for a Product Manager to join the Flex Platform team, a cross-functional product organization responsible for building the shared platform capabilities, workflows, and services that power Cyncly's products globally.

You will own a defined product area end-to-end from understanding customer problems and shaping the product strategy through prioritization, delivery, launch, and measuring outcomes.

This role is ideal for a PM who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, working closely with customers and engineering teams, and turning complex business needs into simple, scalable product experiences. Areas may include business workflows, CRM, payments, integrations, data and analytics, platform services, AI-enabled capabilities, or other emerging platform opportunities.

**About the Team**  
The Flex Platform team operates through small, autonomous, cross-functional pods, with each pod accountable for a defined product area and outcome.

As the PM for your pod, you will be the primary product decision-maker, working closely with engineering, design, QA, architecture, and business stakeholders.

We believe PMs should own outcomes rather than simply manage backlogs. You will have the autonomy to determine what problem to solve, why it matters, what to build, and how to measure whether it worked.

**Key Position Responsibilities include:**  
**Product Discovery & Strategy**

* Understand customer, user, and business problems through research, data, and stakeholder insights.
* Define problems clearly before committing to solutions.
* Develop product hypotheses, evaluate alternatives, and make informed product trade-offs.
* Translate business strategy and customer needs into a clear product vision and roadmap for your area.
* Identify opportunities to create reusable platform capabilities that can scale across products, customers, and markets.

**Product Delivery**

* Own and prioritize the product backlog in partnership with engineering.
* Define product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
* Work closely with engineering, design, QA, and architecture throughout discovery and delivery.
* Make day-to-day product decisions and resolve ambiguity quickly.
* Balance customer needs, technical complexity, business value, and time-to-market.
* Ensure that products are delivered with the right level of quality, usability, and scalability.

**Customer & Stakeholder Management**

* Regularly engage with customers and users to validate problems and solutions.
* Partner with business unit leaders, customer success, sales, and other internal stakeholders.
* Build alignment across teams and communicate product decisions clearly.
* Represent the needs of your product area in quarterly planning and roadmap discussions.

**Outcomes & Continuous Improvement**

* Define measurable outcomes for the products and capabilities you own.
* Track adoption, usage, customer value, and business impact after launch.
* Use data and customer feedback to continuously improve the product.
* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, automate manual processes, and improve customer productivity.

**Cross-Platform Collaboration**

* Work across Flex Platform pods when your product area has dependencies on integrations, APIs, data, AI, payments, or other shared capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to leverage existing platform capabilities rather than building duplicate solutions.
* Help shape platform standards and reusable capabilities that benefit multiple Cyncly products.

**Go-to-Market & Communication**

* Partner with GTM, business units, and customer-facing teams to prepare products for launch.
* Communicate product changes, value propositions, and release plans clearly.
Support customer and internal enablement for significant product launches.  

**Required Experience and Qualifications:**

* 3 - 5 years of product management experience, preferably in a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment.
* Demonstrated experience owning a product area from discovery through delivery and measurable outcomes.
* Strong customer-first mindset and experience conducting customer or user discovery.
* Comfortable owning and prioritizing a backlog without relying on a dedicated Product Owner.
* Strong product judgment and ability to make trade-offs in ambiguous situations.
* Ability to translate complex business problems into simple, intuitive product experiences.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create clear product requirements, user stories, stakeholder communications, and product narratives.
* Comfortable working closely with engineering and understanding technical concepts, APIs, integrations, data, and platform architecture.
* Strong collaboration skills and the ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* Comfortable working across multiple products, business units, geographies, and time zones.
* Data-driven mindset with the ability to define and use product metrics to evaluate success.
Ownership mentality, you take responsibility for outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tasks.  

**Good to Have:**

* Experience building platform products, shared services, or reusable capabilities.
* Experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise applications, or vertical SaaS.
* Experience with APIs, integrations, data platforms, analytics, or workflow automation.
* Experience working with AI-enabled products or automation.
* Experience launching products across multiple markets or geographies.
* Experience working in an autonomous, cross-functional product pod or squad model.
Experience with PLG, self-service products, or SaaS growth models.  

**Working for Us**  
At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills - and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.

Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.

We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone - from every background - to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.

If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in - Come join us.

As a Product Manager with AI experience, you are the link between our users and our engineering team. You will work with users to understand what they need, and you will have the technical skills to work with engineers to deliver it. A key part of the role is finding where AI can save our customers time and effort in inventory management, and turning those opportunities into features that enterprise users love and trust.

You will explore and shape product ideas by interviewing customers, studying competitors, and testing new technology, including AI models, tools, and open source options. * Track progress against plan and fix variances as soon as they appear.

Candidates for this position are preferred to be based in Bangalore, India and will be expected to comply with their team’s hybrid work schedule requirements.
  
  
Senior Manager, Product Management
  
  
**Team:** Customer Technology
  
**Location:** Bengaluru, India (Hybrid)
  
  
Who We Are
  
  
At Wayfair, we're working to make shopping more personal, relevant, and easier for millions of customers.
  
  
The Customer Understanding team builds the intelligence that helps Wayfair better understand what customers like, what they're looking for, and how their needs change over time. We turn customer behavior and signals into shared capabilities that power better search, recommendations, personalization, and shopping experiences.
  
  
This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of Product, AI/ML, and customer experience, solving problems at scale and shaping how Wayfair understands and serves its customers.
  
  
Learn more about our technology teams on the[1] Wayfair Tech Blog.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
**Think big and work backwards from the customer:** Imagine what a great shopping experience could look like, identify gaps in how we understand customers, and define what we need to build.
  
  
**Shape strategy, not just a roadmap:** Challenge assumptions, solve ambiguous problems, and build a clear point of view on where to invest and why.
  
  
**Work at the cutting edge of AI/ML and data:** Partner with ML, Data Science, Data Engineering, and Platform teams to build scalable products, balancing model quality, performance, reliability, and cost.
  
  
**Connect technology to customer impact:** Work with Search, Recommendations, and other teams to turn customer intelligence into better shopping experiences, and validate the impact with experiments.
  
  
**See the bigger picture:** Connect opportunities across teams, customer journeys, and businesses. Bring fresh thinking from industry trends and advances in AI.
  
  
**Navigate complexity and drive progress:** Work across distributed teams with different priorities, build alignment, make trade-offs, and move things forward without waiting for perfect clarity.
  
  
**Own outcomes, not just delivery:** Take products from discovery to launch and adoption, measure real impact, and adapt based on what you learn.
  
  
What We're Looking For
  
  
9+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning complex products and delivering measurable customer or business impact.
  
  
Strong product thinking, with the ability to break down ambiguous problems, identify opportunities, and build a clear strategy.
  
  
Experience working with Engineering, Data Science, or ML teams on data-driven, platform, or algorithmic products.
  
  
Strong analytical skills and experience using customer insights, data, and experimentation to guide decisions.
  
  
Ability to understand technical concepts and trade-offs, while staying focused on customer problems and business outcomes.
  
  
Strong communication and collaboration skills, especially when working across multiple teams and stakeholders.
  
  
It's a Plus If You Have
  
  
Experience in e-commerce, personalization, search, recommendations, or customer data products.
  
  
Familiarity with customer embeddings, intent modeling, recommender systems, or cold-start personalization.
  
  
Experience building ML-powered products or reusable data and intelligence platforms.

Our clients operate in complex, highly regulated industries such as advanced manufacturing, life sciences, pharma, retail, and financial services, where "trusted relationship" is a real requirement, not a buzzword in a pitch deck.

### **Position Summary**

If that sounds like your kind of place, and you're a product leader who loves turning great ideas into great software (and isn't afraid to roll up your sleeves to make it happen), we should talk.

We're looking for a **Senior Software Product Management** professional to lead the strategy, execution, and growth of Phenom Cloud's expanding portfolio of enterprise software products, including innovative AI-powered solutions.

This isn't a role for someone who just manages roadmaps, attends sprint reviews, and asks engineering for status updates. We need someone who takes real ownership, understands how software actually works, knows what customers need, and can turn product challenges into opportunities.

You'll have end-to-end accountability for product strategy, quality, prioritization, and delivery. That means quickly understanding our existing products, identifying what needs improvement, establishing clear priorities, and working closely with engineering to turn requirements into software that actually delivers.

But this isn't just about making products work better. It's about making them more valuable. You'll study the market, understand competitors, identify opportunities for differentiation, and help shape products customers genuinely want to buy.

You'll work directly with executive leadership, collaborate across product and engineering teams, and have meaningful influence over the direction of our software business. We're a growing company, so expect to wear multiple hats. If your ideal role involves a large team handling all the details while you focus exclusively on strategy, this probably isn't your gig.

**For the right entrepreneurial product leader, this is a rare opportunity to take real ownership, make a visible impact, and help scale an innovative software portfolio without navigating layers of corporate bureaucracy.**

### **Duties & Responsibilities**

* Own the strategy, roadmap, quality, prioritization, and overall success of Phenom Cloud's software product portfolio
* Quickly assess existing products, identify functional gaps and usability issues, and drive improvements that make a real difference to customers
* Establish clear product priorities, balancing critical fixes, customer needs, technical considerations, and strategic enhancements

description:
**Overview**

Role: **Senior Product Manager**

Build the commerce engine that powers Copilot's growth.

Every great growth idea, a new offer, a smarter trial, a better upgrade, ends in the same place: a purchase that has to feel effortless and work flawlessly, on every device. You will own the commerce foundations behind Copilot, so that anyone who chooses to pay gets instant access to what they bought, and growth teams can turn a new idea into a live offer in days. This is a growth role disguised as a platform role: the systems you build decide how fast the whole organization can learn.

Why this role, why now

Copilot recently came together as one app across web, desktop and mobile, for consumers and businesses alike. Monetization is moving inside the product, with new plans, add-ons and usage-based offers arriving quickly. Early signals on mobile are solid, and in-app purchase is live across iOS and Android. That makes commerce one of the highest-leverage places to build right now.

How we work

* Small, empowered mission teams with clear ownership.
* Every bet starts with a written hypothesis, is measured rigorously, and decisions are made on evidence.
* AI-native by default: we use AI agents and tools throughout our own workflow to research, prototype, analyze and ship faster.
* Ship fast, learn faster, scale what works.
* India shapes global strategy here, not just execution.

You'll thrive here if…

* You sweat the details of a great purchase moment.
* You know revenue is won or lost in receipts, retries, renewals and edge cases.
* You read API contracts like specs and write your own queries instead of waiting for dashboards.
* You can sketch the state machine for a purchase across store, service and app.
* You move teams you don't manage with clear asks, crisp escalations and a lot of goodwill.
* You form a view, test it and change your mind when the data says so.

This role may not be for you if…

* You want a fully defined backlog handed to you every cycle.
* You prefer strategy decks to working through a tricky purchase flow with engineers.
* Ambiguity across many partner teams drains you rather than motivates you.

Why join us

Few roles give you this much leverage: the commerce foundations you build will shape how millions of people and businesses buy and experience AI. You will own a critical platform for a global product, with the trust to set direction and a fast-moving, AI-native team beside you. If that excites you, we would love to meet you.

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

What you will own

As the dedicated owner of commerce for Copilot Growth, your mission is to make commerce an experimentation platform: growth teams launch new offers and price tests as configuration, not bespoke engineering.

* Offers and entitlements: a clean model for plans, bundles and add-ons, wired correctly from day one.
* Effortless purchase: checkout and purchase flows across web, desktop and mobile, including self-service purchase for businesses.
* Instant access: entitlement that reaches the customer the moment they pay.
* Trials and offers: configurable, targetable and measurable without waiting for an app release.
* App store billing: purchase, renewal and receipts on iOS, Android and Mac, in close partnership with store platforms.
* Usage and recovery: usage-based metering and smooth payment recovery.
* Measurement everywhere: telemetry and experimentation hooks so every commerce change is measured.

You will partner with platform, engineering, finance, tax, legal and store teams, and move metrics such as purchase success, time to access, checkout conversion and experiment lead time.

Your first 30 / 60 / 90 days

* First 30 days: understand every purchase path end to end, and the data and partners behind it.
* By 60 days: a hypothesis-led commerce roadmap your partners back.
* By 90 days: a first improvement shipped, and a growth team launching an offer on your foundations.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree AND 6+ years experience in product management or software development.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Significant experience with commerce, payments, billing, subscriptions or platform products at scale.
* Solid technical depth: API contracts, data schemas, SQL and purchase edge cases.
* Experimentation literacy and a track record of delivering outcomes through teams you don't own.
* App store billing experience (StoreKit, Google Play Billing), including receipt validation.
* Entitlement or licensing systems, or B2B SaaS licensing.
* Fintech, payments or e-commerce experience, including UPI and checkout optimization.
* Pricing and offer engines, SQL or Kusto (KQL), and mentoring other PMs.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**About the Role:**

We're looking for a hands-on Senior Product Manager with experience building B2C consumer internet products. Someone who understands users, can identify the right problems to solve, and knows how to take a product from an idea to launch.

At FOXO, you'll work closely with founders, designers, engineers, and business teams to shape the product roadmap and turn business priorities into products that people find useful and want to keep using.

This role is suited to someone who enjoys taking ownership, working through ambiguity, and being involved in every stage of product development, from understanding user needs to launching features and improving them based on feedback and data.

* Own product initiatives from discovery and planning to launch and ongoing improvements.

* Define product metrics and track how features perform after launch.

* Experience owning product roadmaps and taking initiatives from problem identification through execution.
* Comfort working with product analytics and customer feedback to make product decisions.
* Understanding of key product metrics such as activation, conversion, engagement, retention, and monetisation.
* Ability to write clear PRDs, user stories, product flows, and acceptance criteria.

* Building products that address real user needs.

Microsoft Security is looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to help shape the next generation of security experiences across endpoint.

We are looking for a security-first product leader with strong technical depth and experience building enterprise security products. The ideal candidate brings expertise in areas such as endpoint security, Microsoft Intune, device management or mobile security, along with a strong understanding of how AI is transforming security and product development.

This role requires more than traditional product management. We are looking for someone who can use AI to fundamentally improve the PM craft, accelerating customer discovery, research, analysis, product definition and prototyping, while applying strong judgement to turn insights into the right product investments.

 **Responsibilities**

As a Senior Product Manager, you will:

* Own end-to-end product strategy, roadmap and execution for key endpoint, device and mobile security scenarios.

* Develop a deep understanding of customers, threat trends and emerging security challenges, and translate them into clear product opportunities.

* Partner across engineering, security research, design and product teams to drive clarity, alignment and execution of complex, cross-team security initiatives.

* Define and drive security experiences spanning endpoint protection, detection, investigation and response, device security and mobile protection.

* Identify opportunities to use AI to improve security outcomes, including faster protection, detection, investigation, response and security operations.

* Leverage AI across the product management lifecycle to accelerate customer insights, product analysis, requirements, prototyping and experimentation, enabling faster and higher-quality product decisions.

* Engage directly with enterprise customers, security operations teams and IT administrators to understand unmet needs and validate product direction.

* Make product prioritisation decisions based on security risk, customer impact, product data and business opportunity.

* Define measurable product outcomes and continuously evaluate adoption, effectiveness and customer value.

Required Qualifications

* Significant product management experience delivering complex enterprise or technical products.
* 8 + Yrs of experience in product management

* Strong experience in cybersecurity, security products or closely related enterprise security technologies.

* Proven experience taking major product capabilities from customer problem and product strategy through engineering execution, launch and adoption.

* Strong technical aptitude and the ability to engage deeply with engineering teams on architecture, design and security trade-offs.

* Strong customer orientation, with demonstrated ability to translate customer and market insights into product strategy and priorities.

Every day, Amazon Customer Service associates help millions of customers around the world. Their ability to deliver exceptional customer experiences depends on feeling supported, empowered, and equipped to succeed.
